name: Temporary Residence as Rentista

requirements.blocker_text: Requires monthly income of at least 5 times Argentina's Salario Mínimo Vital y Móvil (minimum vital and mobile wage), derived from assets (financial instruments, real estate, or business stakes) -- income from personal labor does not qualify. Funds must enter Argentina through authorized banking institutions.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying asset-based income routed through Argentine banks

sources.title: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones -- Obtener una residencia temporaria como rentista: 5x SMVM minimum from asset-based income, 1-year duration, RaDEX process

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Argentina). SMVM (Salario Mínimo Vital y Móvil) is periodically adjusted by the Argentine government, so the effective USD/local-currency income figure changes over time -- modeled as a multiple (5x) rather than a fixed currency amount, consistent with how the source itself states it. citizenship_after_months (24) reflects Ley 346's standalone 2-year continuous-legal-residence bar (see ar_naturalisation.json), separate from the pr_after_months figure which reflects the non-MERCOSUR 3-year permanent-residence threshold -- both clocks can run in parallel on this same temporary status.
